description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Cisco is hiring a junior software engineer to support its India ComSec certification efforts for Cisco products. The role focuses on managing test infrastructure, performing security and network testing, organizing certification evidence, and coordinating with engineering teams and accredited labs.
Software Engineer maintaining ComSec certification lab infrastructure, building test networks, executing security tests, and automating procedures

Responsibilities:
• Maintain and manage the lab infrastructure that supports India ComSec certification activities
• Build test networks, including the configuration, installation, and setup of routers, switches, wireless products, and supporting systems
• Implement internal readiness and certification testing against applicable security requirements, recording clear and reproducible results
• Collect, organize, and review technical evidence and certification documentation; maintain test records, trackers, and status updates
• Triage test findings and coordinate with engineering business units and accredited labs to reproduce issues, gather technical recommendations, and support resolution
• Perform remote testing with accredited test centers, with travel up to 10% of the time
• Research, design, develop, and document technical solutions and repeatable procedures using scripting, automation, and responsible AI-assisted tools

Requirements:
• Experience working with Cisco products
• Working knowledge of IP routing protocols and switching technologies (e.g., LAN/WAN, STP, OSPF, BGP, VRRP/HSRP, IPv4, IPv6)
• Ability to build test networks, including configuration and setup of routers, switches, wireless controllers or firewalls
• Understanding of security concepts and frameworks: SSHv2, PKI, IPSec, TLS, AAA, Zero Trust, NIST 800-53
• Community college or higher education in Information Technology/Systems, Computer Science, or engineering, or a similar background, or 4 years additional work experience in a related field

Preferred:
• Direct experience supporting product security certification, compliance testing, or regulated laboratory testing; familiarity with NCCS/ITSAR/Comsec, FIPS 140, Common Criteria, NIST guidance, or related security standards
• CCNA, CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Security, CyberOps Associate, or a comparable networking or cybersecurity certification
• Familiarity with APIs and data models (REST, NETCONF/RESTCONF, YANG, JSON/YAML), and Git
• Familiarity with Linux or Windows administration and virtualized lab environments used to host test tools and supporting services
• Familiarity with AI-assisted tooling and responsible, secure AI usage; ability to document environments with Visio, draw.io, or diagrams-as-code
• Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills; detail oriented, self-motivated, strong time management, and able to work independently and in a team
